cases.name: Diane Elaine Stroud
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Mrs. Stroud served two four-year terms from 1996 to 2003 on the Mentor-on-the-Lake City Council, including one year as council president
Diane was a Mom who took pride in raising her children and caring for her home. She loved to garden and was an excellent cook."
cases.narrative:
On 11/27/2011, police found her body after a family member reported an odor coming from their garage. He hid her body in their garage fOR 6 weeks and told their children she ran away to join a cult. 

When the family member asked about the smell, Stroud claimed that one of the chickens he kept in the back yard had died. But the family member was suspicious enough that she called police.

When police searched the garage, they found Diane Stroud's body. It was encased in a sleeping bag with a garbage bag pulled over her head that was secured with duct tape. Then the sleeping bag was covered with a tarp that was also held down with duct tape.
